title: Country thread batch C2: full-coverage Factbook source register
scope: Full-coverage successor to the batch-1 seed register (country-factbook-batch1-source-register-2026-10-24.json, 25 countries). Every profile in the ten inhabited Factbook region directories at the same pinned upstream commit was extracted verbatim (ocean and antarctica directories are out of scope for a country viewer). Entries lacking the viewer's minimum identity set (name, capital name + coordinates, reference point) are recorded in skipped[] rather than silently dropped. Raw upstream files are not committed; per-file SHA-256 hashes pin them.
